scripts.nuke: rm -rf node_modules client/node_modules server/node_modules client/dist client/.tanstack server/dist test-results playwright-report
scripts.install:all: pnpm install && pnpm --prefix server install && pnpm --prefix client install
scripts.test: pnpm --prefix client run test && pnpm --prefix server run test
scripts.lint: pnpm --prefix client run lint && pnpm --prefix server run lint
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --prefix client run typecheck && pnpm --prefix server run typecheck
